_help: Groovy kiosk settings. Edit with Notepad, save, then close and restart Groovy. lipsLook: "classic" = the lips filter from before 3 Oct (the clinic's choice), "current" = the newer filter. greenScreen: "auto" = body shaping puts the person on the branded background whenever there is a green screen behind them, "off" = never. background: the branded background picture (replace booth\background.jpg with your own, upright 2160 x 3840).
